answer_1.quote: We have presented our analyses and a new dataset of 102 papers annotated with nine attributes to ascertain the different metrics, used currently by authors in NLG across publications in 2023 in both INLG and ACL venues.

answer_2.quote: A total of 98 papers (94.23%) used automatic metrics, a result similar to what was found by van der Lee et al. ( ), who reported 95% of papers using automatic metrics in both ACL tracks and INLG.

answer_4.quote: 59 papers (56.73%) of papers use human evaluations; in contrast, 98 papers (94.23%) used automatic metrics...
answer_4.guideline: We annotated papers with four approaches to their human evaluations: • Papers predominantly either did not perform a human evaluation or if they did, they did not check for a correlation between their automatic and human evaluation results.
